basic_profile.bio: I'm a second-year computer engineering student at the University of Toronto, aiming to transition into a grad program next year. I'm a huge fan of gaming, especially Star Wars: Battlefront II, and I love listening to podcasts from Last Podcast on the Left during my commute. I'm originally from Vancouver and moved to Toronto for school. My typical online hours are late evenings, after classes and homework. Currently single, I work part-time as a tutor for high school students in math and physics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in engineering principles due to my coursework at UofT. I often supplement my learning with online resources and tutorials, especially on topics related to gaming technology and podcasting.
